title: phone-harness/phone-harness: the agent can tap the phone. You still unlock it.
friendlyTitle: Phone Harness lets a helper tap the phone. You still unlock it.
summary: Phone Harness gained 206 stars on GitHub's Python trending list. The repo has 5,342 stars, under MIT. It lets an agent see and tap a phone: iPhone through the mirroring window, Android through adb. The latest tag, 0.3.3, is from 2 November. The repo was pushed on 20 November.
friendlySummary: Phone Harness gained 206 stars on GitHub's Python trending list. The repo has 5,342 stars, under a free MIT license. It lets a helper see and tap a phone. On iPhone it uses the mirroring window. On Android it uses a debug link. The latest tagged version, 0.3.3, is from 2 November. The repo was updated on 20 November.
whyItMatters: Use it only on a phone you control, and only for a task you can watch. The README says connecting the phone is your job, that text recognition sees words rather than icons, and that a locked screen still needs you. A tap the agent sends is a tap on your account.
